title: Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.00365v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. translated_title: 流形约束的初始噪声优化实现高效生成模型对齐
translated_abstract: 近期蒸馏与流映射模型的进展使高质量数据的一步或几步确定性生成成为可能，并催生了一类新的奖励对齐方法，这类方法直接优化来自高斯分布的初始噪声。然而，大多数现有的初始噪声优化方法依赖于一阶梯度信息，这在黑盒奖励场景中要么无法适用，要么存在不稳定和低效的问题。本文提出ZeNOVA，一种稳定且高效的免梯度初始噪声对齐方法。具体而言，我们通过退火软值引导、流形约束的超球面朗之万动力学以及Metropolis-Hastings跳跃机制，解决了现有算法在黑盒场景中的主要难题。在图像和视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，ZeNOVA通过将初始噪声朝更高质量方向优化，性能优于所有被评估的零阶基线方法。
tldr: 提出ZeNOVA，一种免梯度的初始噪声优化方法，通过退火软值引导、流形约束超球面朗之万动力学和Metropolis-Hastings跳跃，在黑盒奖励场景下实现稳定高效的生成模型对齐。
en_tdlr: ZeNOVA is a gradient-free initial noise optimization method that achieves stable and efficient generative model alignment in black-box reward scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping.
